title: Nimble Dutch Beef Burger
description: A peppery, light Dutch-inspired beef burger featuring ground beef, tangy pickles, and whole30-friendly toppings.
instructions: Combine ground beef, egg, diced pickle, chopped onion, minced garlic, mustard, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl and mix until evenly blended.
Divide the mixture into two equal portions and shape each into a round patty about 1.5 cm thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a splash of olive oil.
Cook the patties for 3-4 minutes on one side until browned, then flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes until cooked through and firm.
Remove the patties from the skillet and let them rest on a paper towel for a minute.
Warm the burger buns briefly in the same skillet, about 30 seconds per side.
Assemble each burger by placing a lettuce leaf on the bottom bun, adding the patty, and topping with a few pickle slices.
Cap with the top bun and serve immediately.
Optional: squeeze a small amount of mustard over the patty before closing the bun for extra flavor.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
